job.title: Onsite Senior SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Richardson

tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | 5+ years SAP Commerce experience
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, REST/OCC APIs, data-pipeline integration with PIM/ERP/MDM, and platform customization. Proven record in architecture design, performance tuning, CI/CD, and techno-functional business analysis supporting global e-commerce operations.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Onsite Senior SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Richardson
cover_en.hook: I am excited about the opportunity at Richardson because your focus on cutting-edge e-commerce aligns with my passion for delivering robust SAP Commerce solutions. With over five years of hands-on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) development at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have built and customized large-scale platforms that drive revenue and customer satisfaction.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Development
bullets.text: Delivered end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) solutions at Rockwell Automation, covering product catalog, pricing and customer data using Java and Spring.

bullets.label: API & Integration Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and exposed OCC REST web services and built PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines (Profisee, Hotfolders, DataHub) to synchronize global product information.

bullets.label: Architecture & Customization
bullets.text: Engineered platform extensions, custom interceptors, populators and converters, and led API migrations that improved system stability and data consistency.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: Collaborated with international business stakeholders to analyse requirements, write user stories and functional specs, and support production UAT and troubleshooting.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, with a valid work permit. Serving notice until 15 December 2026, earliest start 16 December 2026. Available for an interview at your convenience.

tailoring.why_company: Richardson is renowned for its innovative e-commerce platforms that serve a global client base. I am drawn to your commitment to leveraging SAP Commerce Cloud to create seamless, scalable shopping experiences. My background in architecting and customizing Hybris solutions for multinational enterprises positions me to contribute immediately to your ambitious roadmap and help Richardson stay at the forefront of digital commerce.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join Richardson to apply my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to your innovative e-commerce projects and help drive superior customer experiences.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a Senior SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer with 5+ years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m eager to discuss how I can contribute to Richardson’s e-commerce initiatives. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Senior SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer – Richardson
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer role at Richardson. With over five years of hands-on experience delivering and customizing SAP Commerce solutions for global enterprises, I am confident I can add immediate value to your team.

I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit further.
